name: Movement: reach the circle
description: Spawn facing a random way with random boost and get to the circle as fast as you can: on the floor, up a side wall, on the ceiling or on the wall above a goal. Reach it and the next circle appears at once: keep your speed and your boost. Timed per circle: beat your best.
notes: The ball is shrunk out of sight and held on the floor at centre for the whole rep (ball cam still points at it).
